title: AP/AR ON shows the 7 sensitive customer fields on Edit Customer
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View and Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Edit Customer window for a customer.
  2. Find the 7 sensitive fields.
  3. Edit one and save.
custom_expected:
All 7 fields are shown.

The edit is saved.
